plain_text:
In the People's Democratic Republic of Lao, the COVID-19 pandemic is
increasingly affecting the mental health of the population. In a country
with few mental health-care facilities, reaching out to the community
and supporting people at primary health care level will provide a lifeline
to many, especially those who are vulnerable. The country is now taking
major steps to deliver mental health care nationwide as part of a long-
term national effort.
